# Every route `agentry serve` registers: pattern, owner, access kind. Written by
# `go test ./internal/web -run TestTheRouteTableIsUpToDate -update`; reviewers read its diff.
# The server has a task terminal, the Claude helper's terminal, the desk, workers
# (their routes and the shared files' blobs) and the extensions serve installs: ideas, schedules.
GET /                                                    web                          open
GET /api/agents                                          the agents domain            UI
POST /api/agents                                         the agents domain            UI
POST /api/agents/redact                                  the settings domain          UI
POST /api/agents/redact/preview                          the settings domain          UI

GET /api/agents/{name}/knowledge                         the agents domain            UI

POST /api/agents/{name}/rename                           the agents domain            UI

GET /api/config                                          web                          UI
GET /api/desk/terminal                                   web                          UI
GET /api/features                                        web                          UI
GET /api/ideas                                           the ideas extension          UI
POST /api/ideas/{idea}/accept                            the ideas extension          UI
POST /api/ideas/{idea}/dismiss                           the ideas extension          UI
POST /api/integrations/claude-code                       the connections domain       UI
